## Où j'en suis
Built `cmd/replay` on branch `lior/replay-12-11` to re-ingest the 12/11 incident window (14:10–17:40 UTC) from the raw S3 archive: archive reader with per-partition ordering, dedup check, counters, rejects file, and a topic allowlist. A dry run on the real archive (`replay-dryrun-2`, 19m42s) found 18,442,107 events to replay into `events.replay.v3` and 3,118 schema-v2 lines routed to the rejects file. PR #233 is open for review; the real replay and the aggregator backfill have not been run.

- [en-cours] real replay into `events.replay.v3` not started; aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12 pending
- [prochaine-étape] once Daniel has reviewed #233, run the real replay, then the aggregator backfill
- [essai-raté] `--batch 50000` OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; re-ran at 5k batch, 310 MiB peak
- [décision] no age cutoff, replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never produce directly to `events.v3` (source: t05)
- [décision] use batch 5k and leave the namespace memory limit untouched (source: t13)
- [décision] write skipped malformed lines to a rejects file instead of skipping silently (source: t15)
